content: We formulate our problem as a single label classification problem. Given a set of training documents, which we will refer as corpus, $D = \lbrace d_i\rbrace _{i=1}^{|D|}$ , with known classes $C = \lbrace c_j\rbrace _{j=1}^{|C|}$ , we wish to classify a query document $d_q$ into one of the classes in $C$ .
